description:
Harang, a white-furred cat shapeshifter. Unlike typical carnivorous shapeshifters, she possesses a frail body and physical abilities, which led to her being constantly bullied while growing up in an orphanage. Although she manages to make a living as a postal civil servant, she is once again living as an outcast at work due to malicious rumors spread by her boss after she refused his unreasonable demands. Through a chance encounter, she discovers that she is a wizard.

Carl Riverson, an agent belonging to a special forces unit for shapeshifters. He came to Terberat, far from his original workplace, on leave of absence. On his first day of moving here, he encounters Harang again—a shapeshifter from his memories who left a vivid impression on him as a child and continues to influence him even into adulthood. Determined never to let Harang go, Carl begins to actively court her.
